title: Agent Ingest, Audit and Optimize client adapter
description: Documentation for humans and external tools. The bundle carries no JSON Schema library and never grows one: `ledgerlib.adapters.validate_adapter` is what actually runs at load time. `SchemaAgreementTests` in dashboard/tests/test_adapters.py compares this file against that validator in both directions, because the two drift the moment nothing compares them.

expires_on.description: Vendor paths are time-sensitive evidence. `scan` emits a finding, not an error, when it runs an adapter past this date.

anchors.description: Anchor name to an ordered list of candidate roots. A candidate is `$env:NAME` -- the value of that environment variable, skipped when unset or empty -- or `$platform:<system>:<path>`, applying only where `sys.platform` starts with `<system>` and skipped textually before any filesystem call otherwise -- or a filesystem path with a leading `~` expanded; a relative candidate resolves against the project. The first candidate that resolves to an existing directory wins. If none does the anchor is unresolved and every probe under it is recorded not_present -- EXCEPT when every candidate was skipped by a platform guard, in which case the anchor is not applicable on this platform and its probes are skipped entirely, producing no items and a note: nothing was looked at, so no absence was verified.

probes.description: May be empty. generic.json's whole point is an adapter that probes nothing.

sensitive_key_patterns.description: fnmatch patterns, matched case-insensitively against key names. A matching key's value is replaced by a digest and never copied.

resolution.description: Optional -- the one top-level field that is, so a version-1 adapter stays valid. Maps a baseline item kind to how the client resolves that kind across scopes; a kind absent here is undeclared, which `drift` reports rather than guessing. Spec docs/specs/2026-07-30-drift-and-rollback-preview.md section 3.1. The key enum is the same closed kind enum probes use, held to `constants.BASELINE_ITEM_KINDS` by an agreement test.

kind.description: The same closed enum `baselines[].items[].kind` validates against. `ledgerlib.adapters` imports `constants.BASELINE_ITEM_KINDS` rather than restating these ten strings, and an agreement test fails if this list and that set diverge in either direction.

scope.description: Copied onto the item's attributes. `scan` records the layer an item came from and computes no precedence winner.

glob.description: Anchored pattern, expanded under its resolved anchor. Passes `check_glob` at load time: a `..` segment or an absolute form is refused before a single probe runs.

path.description: Anchored path, yielding exactly one item. Passes `check_glob` at load time, identically to `glob`.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointer selecting a sub-document; one item per key at that location.

mode.description: `override` is the only mode `drift` computes a winner under; the other three declare that no per-item winner is well-formed.

order.description: Highest precedence first. Required under `override` and `key-override`, forbidden under `merge` and `concatenate`, and must name exactly the scopes the probes of this kind declare -- `validate_adapter` refuses an ordering that cannot rank every item it will meet, at load rather than at drift time.
